_readme: The burger menu cut (Plan 07 section 3). options: one per layer, top layer first; the number of layers always equals the number of top-level menu options (2 to 6). cuts: one polyline per boundary between two layers, as [x, y] points in pixels of Design/scene/burger.webp (1536x1024), left to right, following the real edges of the burger (the bun's underside, the bacon's lower edge, the sauce line) rather than a straight line; they must not cross. plateSplit: the outline of the sauce and bottom bun, so the plate (everything else in the last layer) can fade on its own. mask: how the burger and plate are found automatically (brightness thresholds above and below splitY, the plate's rim as an ellipse, and the columns where the burger can be); add a maskPolygon (a list of [x, y]) to replace that with a hand-made outline. After editing, run the build and look at reports/build-report.html (burger layer sheet).
